name: Fire29 irregular low flame fronts
description: Keep current six scattered placements, bright warm orange/red palette and source floor movement. Replace the little triangular candles/cones: they merely stretch vertically. We need BROAD IRREGULAR LOW FIRE growing from the existing horizontal burning streaks. Make each flame front30-44px wide and only6-18px high, with2-3 asymmetrical overlapping lobes of different widths, no single central sharp apex. A lobe grows along a short section of the burning streak, bulges outward/upward, splits into two short rounded tips, then recedes while a nearby lobe grows. This is redrawing connected flame contours, not whole-shape bending/scaling or isolated cone height changes. Inner luminous core should spread along the base and follow the irregular body, never form a vertical candle wick. Preserve painted orange texture and soft red edges, bright orange interior and small warm highlights for volume; no brown rocks or flat opaque curtains. Root/base connects broadly to original glowing bands. Keep four interior fronts and only two rim spills. At rim keep visible6-10gamepixel overlap at peak; interior motion must remain readable too. Avoid synchronized breathing, repeated symmetric crown shapes, regular spacing, thin needles, sparks, jets, smoke and brightness pulses. Smooth calm32frames20fps seamless loop, steady light intensity. Low ground fire, not six campfire icons.
